summary: payment-service could not reach postgres-primary after a config change reduced the connection pool size; requests started timing out under normal load
root_cause: A config change lowered the max connection pool size for payment-service from 50 to 10, which was insufficient for peak traffic, causing connection pool exhaustion against postgres-primary.
fix: Reverted the connection pool size config and added an alert on pool saturation above 80%.
fix_commands: kubectl set env deployment/payment-service DB_POOL_SIZE=50 -n prod
